name: Commercial Foods

about:
Founded in 1984, Commercial Food Systems, Inc. is an Indiana-owned and operated food distribution company headquartered in Indianapolis. Anthony Gates serves as president of the business, which began with a focus on providing customer-centric service to institutional foodservice operators.

The company distributes a broad range of products including beverages, breakfast items, fruits, snacks, condiments, single-portion packs, bulk items, holiday cookies, concessions, signage, equipment, paper goods, and kitchen wares. It operates without contracts, minimum orders, or delivery and fuel surcharges, and provides an online ordering platform, procurement support, and nutritional documentation for compliance with programs such as Smart Snacks and Buy American.

Commercial Food Systems serves three primary segments: K-12 schools, day care centers, and health care facilities. Its customer base includes Indiana Educational Service Centers, the Greater Chicagoland area, and the western third of Ohio. Testimonials reference long-standing relationships with districts such as Jennings County Schools, Western Wayne, and Plainfield Community Schools.

The company cites its dedication to customer service and its role as a premier partner and industry advisory council member of the Indiana School Nutrition Association as key differentiators. It emphasizes a product portfolio built around compliant beverages, Smart Snacks, and small equipment, maintaining that its service model has remained consistent since its founding.
